title: Baby in Wooden Playpen at Outdoor Family Picnic, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Black and white vintage snapshot showing an infant sitting inside a wooden slatted playpen placed on the grass during an outdoor family gathering. In the background behind the wooden bars, a woman wearing a checkered apron looks on attentively from a picnic setup. Dated July 31, 1949, capturing a charming slice of post-WWII domestic life in mid-century America.
